name: Le Carnet Bleu
description: A setting-aware six-person live murder mystery with one host and five suspect seats.

authoring.instructions: Collect and validate the real setting before drafting characters, clues, physical actions, or the canonical solution. Never assume the demo house is the venue.

settingQuestions.prompt: What is the real venue called, and what kind of place is it?
Where is the venue, and which local details should the story use?
Why are the players gathering, and what will really happen during the evening?
Should the fiction be present-day, historical, timeless, or another specific era?
Which rooms or outdoor areas may be used during play?
How can players safely move between those spaces, and which routes are off-limits?
Which real features could become clues or story elements?
Which costumes and safe props already exist or can easily be prepared?
What tone should the evening have?
What physical, privacy, timing, or venue rules must never be crossed?
Does anyone need seated play, step-free routes, larger text, lower sensory load, or another accommodation?
Which themes, relationships, or kinds of harm should the story avoid?

commands.name: replace_enrolment
commands.description: Replace the editable host, seats and venue proof.

commands.name: prepare
commands.description: Lock the roster and create unsent delivery records.

commands.name: begin_delivery
commands.description: Record that a queued delivery attempt began.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start play after every human dossier is confirmed delivered.

commands.name: record_ai_performance
commands.description: Persist the bounded output produced for one AI-controlled authored action.

commands.name: advance_act
commands.description: Advance to the next authored act or begin investigation after completing the current act.

commands.name: toggle_evidence
commands.description: Mark evidence as surfaced or withdrawn.

commands.name: reveal
commands.description: Lock the accusation and enter the canonical reveal.
